comparison.objective: Connect and tighten an M12 sensor cable while counterholding a loose sensor, not commission a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually counterholds a sensor while turning a coupling ring after axial connector engagement; candidate counterholds a damper while unlocking, tuning, and relocking with a hex key.
comparison.success_condition: Connector on and tight after one relative turn, cap tray-stowed, hands released versus two acceptable dynamic cycles and post-lock drift test.
comparison.reason: This is the closest manipulation overlap, but it tests connector engagement and screw-coupling completion, not iterative response-based adjustment with a separate lock.
